import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long x_input, y_input, max_b;
    static double min_difference = Double.MAX_VALUE;
    static Pair result;

    static class Pair {
        long b, a;
        Pair(long b, long a) {
            this.b = b;
            this.a = a;
        }
    }

    static void try_update(long b_value, long a_value) {
        double diff = Math.abs((double)a_value / b_value - (double)x_input / y_input);
        if (diff + 1e-15 < min_difference) {
            min_difference = diff;
            result = new Pair(b_value, a_value);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        x_input = sc.nextLong();
        y_input = sc.nextLong();
        max_b = sc.nextLong();

        for (long b = 1; b <= max_b; b++) {
            long a_floor = (x_input * b) / y_input;
            long a_ceil = a_floor + 1;
            try_update(b, a_floor);
            try_update(b, a_ceil);
        }
        System.out.println(result.a + "/" + result.b);
        sc.close();
    }
}
</translated_code>
